Importance of Tonsils in Your Immune System

Did you know that your tonsils play an important role in protecting your body from infections?
Tonsils are two small masses of lymphoid tissue located on either side of the throat, known as the palatine tonsils. They act as the body's first line of defense by helping trap germs and supporting the immune system.
However, tonsils can sometimes become enlarged or infected, leading to symptoms such as sore throat, difficulty swallowing, snoring, bad breath, or recurrent throat infections.
Common Causes of Enlarged Tonsils:
✔️ Bacterial Infections
✔️ Viral Infections
✔️ Allergies
✔️ Environmental Factors

I took the medication for a week as advised by this doctor only to end up with the throat pain getting worse wherein now I have this horrible swollen throat which is constantly itchy and has nothing to do with any form of acid reflux. Thankfully another doctor recognized it right away and suggested that I stop taking the medication advised by this doctor as it would not help me ameliorate my throat infection and pain that I have been experiencing. This is what happens when you entrust your body with such inexperienced doctors. In addition at the time of consultation, this doctor Partha spoke in an extremely patronizing tone as if he was doing some favour on me by diagnosing my issue. Never going to this doctor ever again, whose only purpose is to lust for money with no desire to treat patients well.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS DOCTOR ONE BIT!!! I HAVE ALSO LEARNT FROM OTHER PATIENTS, THAT FOR THROAT ISSUE THIS DOCTOR SUGGESTS THE EXACT SAME MEDICATION!!
